title: Business Development Manager - EPC
description:
**Company Description**

Rexel in India, is a fully owned INR 850 cr + subsidiary of Rexel Global, having presence in the country with 16 branches and 16 stock points, from where we are serving customers on a Pan Inda level. We offer a wide variety of products across various categories covering length and breadth of the Industrial Automation, Lighting requirements, Panels and Supply Chain Consolidation (C-Class Direct and Indirect material purchases) for plants and offices. We are a one stop source for your business needs ranging from Stationery, office supplies to Industrial Automation.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

**We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive revenue growth from EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) customers. The role will focus on developing and managing relationships with EPC firms, identifying project opportunities, preparing technical-commercial proposals in collaboration with engineering teams, and leading negotiations to secure turnkey industrial automation, SCADA/DCS, Safety systems, LV/HT electrical panels projects across any sector where EPCs undertake projects — including but not limited to pharmaceuticals, data centers, semiconductor fabs, oil & gas, chemicals, utilities, and heavy industries. A background in handling EPC customers and understanding their procurement and project execution practices will be a significant advantage.**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Identify, target and develop strategic relationships with EPC contractors, consultants and principal clients across sectors where EPCs execute projects.**
* **Source and qualify new project opportunities (greenfield, brownfield, retrofit, upgrade) across EPC-led projects.**
* **Lead pre-sales activities: gather client requirements, coordinate technical scoping with engineering, prepare value-based commercial proposals and tender responses.**
* **Develop and present solution-focused proposals and presentations that articulate Rexel’s end-to-end capabilities (concept, control system design, FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, lifecycle support).**
* **Negotiate commercial terms, contracts and scope of work with EPC partners and clients in coordination with legal and finance teams.**
* **Maintain accurate opportunity pipeline and sales forecasts using CRM; drive timely follow-up and closure.**
* **Work closely with project management and engineering to ensure smooth handover from sales to delivery and to manage client expectations.**
* **Participate in bid reviews, risk assessments and post-bid debriefs to improve win-rates.**
* **Monitor market trends, competitor activity and EPC procurement practices; feed market intelligence into product/service development.**
* **Represent Rexel at industry events, trade shows, supplier/vendor meetings and client site visits.**
* **Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets and KPIs.**

  
**Qualifications**

**qualification & Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of proven business development / sales experience selling to EPC contractors, ideally in industrial automation, process control, electrical & instrumentation, or related engineering services.
* Demonstrated experience handling EPC customers and familiarity with EPC procurement cycles, contracts and project execution practices is a strong advantage.
* Deep understanding of EPC project lifecycle, procurement cycles and commercial models (EPC, EPCM, LSTK).
* Experience with SCADA, DCS, PLC, safety instrumented systems, and turnkey automation project sales is highly desirable.
* Existing network and relationships with EPCs and principal clients across multiple sectors is a plus.
* Strong commercial acumen, proposal writing and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, project management, procurement, legal and finance.
* Willingness to travel to client sites and industry events as required.

Key Competencies:

* Strategic account management
* Consultative / solution selling
* Technical understanding of automation systems
* Contract negotiation and commercial structuring
* CRM proficiency (e.g., DCRM, Salesforce, HubSpot) and pipeline management
* Results-driven with strong problem-solving skills
* Team player with high ethical standards

title: Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and

Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate

cloud, data and AI transformation.

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led

business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate

within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,

hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.

The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity

orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer

conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler

capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.

The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,

influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud

technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed

sales/revenue targets.

* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.

  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.

* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.

Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and

strategy.

* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.

  

* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives

and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.

* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and

hyperscaler platforms.

* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.

  

* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition,

stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.

* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
Drive opportunities from initial qualification solution shaping proposal

negotiation closure.

C. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS

  

* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.

**7. Internal Orchestration**
=============================

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:

Client Manager BU Cloud Specialist Presales/Solution Architecture Delivery Hyperscaler Commercial/Finance

Responsibilities include:

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.

Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

Required Qualifications:

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.

consulting organisation preferred.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

Technical & Business Skills

Strong understanding of:

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services

* Cloud security

* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation

* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management

* Cross-functional influence

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

* Record and reconcile:
* Labour revenue
* Spare parts sales
* Warranty claims
* Insurance jobs

**3. Cash & Bank Management**

* Daily cash reconciliation (cash, UPI, card payments)
* Bank reconciliation statements (BRS)
* Monitor cash flow and working capital

**4. Inventory & Spare Parts Accounting**

* Track spare parts inventory valuation
* Coordinate with parts department for stock audits
* Monitor slow-moving and non-moving inventory
* Ensure correct costing (FIFO / weighted average)

**5. MIS & Reporting (Dealer Principal Level)**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports:
* Revenue per RO (Repair Order)
* Labour vs parts ratio
* Technician productivity
* Gross profit margins
* Present reports to **Dealer Principal / Director**

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* GST compliance:
* Input/output reconciliation
* Filing returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B)
* TDS deductions and filings
* Ensure compliance with local financial regulations

**7. OEM & Internal Reporting**

* Support internal and external audits

**8. Cost Control & Profitability**

* Monitor departmental expenses

title: Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Support EMEA Fixed Income Derivatives Sales with pricing, structuring, analytics, and client materials; automate workflows

As a Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst within the EMEA Sales team (Markets Group, CIB Research & Analytics) you will be responsible for supporting sales coverage through interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients. You will structure and price vanilla and bespoke derivatives using internal models, run analytics, and quantify key market and credit risks. You will work on trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macro drivers and internal/external research and analysing payoff profiles for client objectives. You will create tailored client materials (pitchbooks, factsheets, and market analysis) and articulate product rationale in the current environment. You will support end-to-end trade execution and lifecycle processes while driving automation and process improvements using Python/VBA.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support Fixed Income Derivatives sales/marketing coverage by understanding client objectives and identifying suitable interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients
* Structure and price derivative solutions (vanilla and bespoke) using internal flow pricing models and by combining option strategies, and run relevant analytics to support pricing metrics and quantify market/credit risks
* Generate trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macroeconomic drivers and external/internal research, and optimizing payoff profiles for the target client base
* Create client materials for meetings including tailored pitchbooks/factsheets and market analysis, articulate product rationale for the current environment and backtest strategy outcomes where applicable
* Manage end-to-end trade support across the lifecycle including instrument setup/creation, booking support, term sheet preparation, note issuance coordination, and responding to post-trade client queries (settlements, lifecycle calculations, reconciliations, and documentation checks)
* Drive process improvement and automation for the sales team by building tools to streamline recurring workflows and daily tasks using Python/VBA

**Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:**

* Strong knowledge of derivatives and greeks – indices, futures, and options
* Strong knowledge of Equities, Rates, FX, and Commodities
* Knowledge of VBA and any object-oriented programming language (specifically Python)
* Close attention to detail and ability to work at very high standards of precision
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Good communication and team skills in a multi-location set up

* Clear, logical thinker with strong qualitative skill set
* Strong team player that partners well with stakeholders

Meet the Team
  
  
Our team acts as a trusted technical partner for our customers, helping them navigate the complexities of hybrid and multi-cloud environments. title: Sales Executive
description:
Industry - Education

Working Days - Monday to Saturday

Location - Marine Lines

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Identify loan need** Work with counsellors to flag students likely to need funding at the counselling stage, not after the offer letter. The earlier a **early** case starts, the higher the chance the student actually flies.

**Assess and match** Understand the student's profile — course, university, country, co-applicant income, collateral available, existing obligations — and match to lenders realistically likely to sanction. Secured versus unsecured, margin money, moratorium terms, processing fees, rate of interest.

**Present real** Give every student a written comparison of at least two suitable lenders, showing rate, tenure, margin, collateral requirement **options** and total cost. The student chooses. You advise.

**Manage** Own the file: KYC, academic records, income proof, collateral documents, offer letter. Most rejections and delays are **documentation** documentation failures. Preventing them is the job.

**Drive to** Track every case from application through sanction to actual disbursement. A sanction that never disburses is not a result. **disbursement** Chase lenders, chase students, chase valuers.

**Handle rejections** Where a case is declined, understand exactly why and reposition it with a different lender or a restructured application. Do not return a student to their counsellor with a no and nothing else.

**Deliver partner** Know where each lending partner stands against expected volume. Maintain working relationships with partner relationship **commitments** managers.

**CRM and reporting** Every case logged and staged accurately. Weekly Excel reporting on pipeline, sanction rate, disbursement value, turnaround time and partner-wise split — built and maintained by you.

**HOW WE ADVISE ON LENDERS**

**The student's cost of borrowing comes first.** Recommend based on what the student can realistically get and what it will cost them over the life of the loan — not on our commercial arrangement with any lender. Every student is shown a comparison of at least two options in writing, and is told plainly that we have a commercial relationship with its lending partners. Any pressure to steer a student towards a more expensive product should be escalated immediately.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Must have**

* 2–4 years in education loans, retail lending, banking, NBFC or DSA sales, with targets attached.
* Working knowledge of secured and unsecured education loans: co- applicant assessment, collateral, margin money, moratorium, sanction and disbursement process.

title: Payments Cross-Currency Solutions Specialist - Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Job summary**

JPMorgan Payments is looking for a business development / solutions Vice President to execute our Cross-Currency Solutions growth strategy. FX and global payments are critical drivers of the international growth agenda for the Payments and FX business.

The Cross-Currency Solutions Vice President will drive the accelerated growth of the regional and cross-regional Cross-Currency Solutions P&L through a full range of sales and advisory activities.

The role serves as a subject matter expert in Cross-Currency Solutions, actively supporting client solution pitches, identifying opportunities for growth and digitalizing clients' workflows. The incumbent acts as an advisor and extension of sales for the Payment Sales Managers and Global Corporate Bankers, helping to win new business through Request for Proposals, Differentiated Solution Pitches and leveraging client relationships.

In addition, the role serves as the voice of the client—channeling client feedback and competitive intelligence back to our product partners to strengthen product and solution features. Cross-Currnecy Solution Specialists stay closely aligned to product governance, legal/compliance/regulatory requirements, market practice and technology/operational constraints. This proximity enables early validation of feasibility, reduces late-stage surprises and rework, and ensures solutions are productized in a way that can be replicated across clients and segments.  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* **Distinct accountability and partnership model:** Lead solution feasibility and productization strategy for regulated and complex payment / foreign exchange control-enabled flows, working in close partnership with: **Product** (owns product vision/roadmap and approval forums); **Payments Sales** (owns go-to-market execution, pipeline shaping and client engagement, as applicable)
* Drive the outlined strategy for growing the Cross-Currency APAC P&L for the assigned portfolio, leveraging existing JPMorgan relationship, developing new relationships with Corporate Banking and Payments Sales, and CDM Marketer.
* **Sales enablement for simple cross-currency payment flows for a defined set of client portfolio**: Train relevant coverage partners on cross-currency payment capabilities, including spot foreign exchange payment solutions available via supported payment platforms. This includes the end-to-end payment flow from initiation through automated payment processing, tracking and client reporting.
* **Ownership of complex flow / foreign exchange control-enabled solutions**: Serve as the primary solution partner for complex client needs, working with Sales (and other stakeholders when applicable) to configure or tailor existing capabilities. As a client-facing Vice President, drive organic growth by increasing penetration with existing clients and pitching solutions to new clients, including proposal responses and bundling of products & solutions, and educate clients on new ways of execution.
* **Governance, legal and regulatory rigor (continuous, not episodic):** Ensure governance and regulatory alignment are embedded throughout the client solutioning lifecycle. Stay current on product approvals, policy constraints, licensing/regulatory requirements and required controls—reducing late-stage surprises and minimizing rework when feasibility checks happen too late.
* **Structured translation layer between Sales and Product:** Convert pipeline signals, proposal inputs and client feedback into actionable product requirements, enhancement requests and prioritization inputs. Translate roadmap constraints into clear client positioning, field-ready enablement and guidance on what is feasible now vs. later. Work with Sales to maintain a healthy client pipeline, ensuring involvement across the sales cycle from opportunity identification through solution pitches and winning mandates. The role is expected to support multiple client segments and industries in India and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Coordination between Payments Sales, Corporate and Commercial Banks and CDM Markets for pro-active and target client calling, develop and present client relevant and thoughtful solution presentations and set-out pricing strategy for all of the Cross-Currency Solutions.

**Key skills**

* **Cross-border payments and FX expertise**: strong understanding of cross-currency payment flows, foreign exchange, client implementation considerations and operating/processing constraints
* **Regulatory and controls mindset**: ability to operate effectively within governance frameworks, legal/compliance requirements, and local regulatory expectations applicable to cross-border transactions
* **Advisory and Solutioning**: capability to assess feasibility early, design repeatable solutions, and standardize patterns that can scale across clients and segments, while taking an consultative approach going beyond the standard product offering.
* **Commercial acumen and client-facing leadership**: strong executive presence, ability to influence outcomes, and proven experience supporting complex solution pitches and proposal responses
* **Stakeholder management**: demonstrated ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Implementation and Service teams
* **Analytical and structured problem solving**: ability to leverage data and structured thinking to prioritize opportunities, develop replication strategies, and deliver clear recommendations
* **Globalized view**: ability to recognize patterns across markets and segments, apply global standards with local expertise.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in cross-border payments, transaction banking/cash management and/or FX-related solutions
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows and the practicalities of delivery and execution in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience partnering across Product, Sales and delivery organizations to deliver client outcomes
* Track record in complex client solutioning, commercialization and supporting proposal responses
* Understanding of APAC regulatory environment related to cash management, account services and foreign exchange
* BA or BS from a top-tier program or equivalent level education preferred
* Minimum of 8 years+ of relevant work experience
* Exceptional writing, verbal communication and client facing skills

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

**Strong Plus**
---------------

* Exadata-specific depth: IORM policy tuning, smart scan diagnostics, storage server failure recovery, and hardware lifecycle decision-making
* Kubernetes-native data platform experience with stateful workload operators (Strimzi, Cassandra Operator, OpenSearch Operator, Redis Operator)
* Experience with AIOps or observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) including custom exporter and agent development
* Familiarity with agentic integration patterns (MCP, tool-use APIs) for building AI-augmented operational toolchains
* Hands-on coding in Python, Go, or shell scripting — enough to design and ship internal tooling independently
* Background in security or compliance-adjacent industries where data integrity and auditability carry regulatory weight

**Who This Role Is For**
========================

This role is for a data platform leader who still gets pulled in by a gnarly execution plan, and who sees a recurring on-call alert as a signal that something needs to be built — then builds it. You lead by doing as much as by directing, and your team follows you because they know you have sat in their chair.

You hold Oracle's feet to the fire in a negotiation and hold your engineers to a high bar in a design review. You speak reliability to a DBA and business risk to a CFO. You don't wait to be handed a mandate — you see the gap, take the charter, and grow the team around it. You balance operating rigorously today with shaping the platform for where the business will be in three years.

If you are energized by owning something truly foundational — the data layer that everything else at Qualys depends on — and you want to build the next generation of AI-driven reliability engineering, we would like to hear from you.

**This Role Is Not For**
------------------------

* DBAs focused on ticket-based operations who are not comfortable driving architectural decisions and organizational change
* Leaders who are not hands-on in production systems — this role requires genuine technical engagement, not just team management
* Candidates whose AI experience is limited to tool adoption — we need operators who have shipped agents and measured the impact
* Candidates who need full-stack mastery on day one — we value depth in core areas and intellectual range over checklist coverage

**About Qualys**
================

Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based security, compliance, and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.

Qualys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see our EEO policy for details.

title: Data Entry Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Data Entry Executive with e-commerce and AI skills to join our growing team in India. The candidate will be responsible for entering, updating, organizing, and maintaining product data, customer records, supplier details, spreadsheets, digital files, and information on the company’s e-commerce website.

The candidate will regularly upload new products, update existing listings, make website content changes, organize product categories, manage images and specifications, and ensure that all online product information is complete, accurate, and professionally presented.

The ideal candidate should be accurate, organized, consistent, and able to follow instructions carefully. They should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, organize information, prepare product content, identify errors, and complete routine administrative and e-commerce tasks more efficiently.

AI tools should be used to support the work, but all information must be manually reviewed and verified before publishing.

Key Responsibilities

**Data Entry:** Enter and update product details, prices, descriptions, specifications, customer information, supplier records, and other company data accurately.

**E-Commerce Product Uploads:** Upload new products to the company’s e-commerce website, including product names, descriptions, prices, specifications, dimensions, materials, colours, finishes, images, categories, and other required information.

**Product Listing Management:** Update and maintain existing product listings, correct inaccurate information, replace images, revise descriptions, add new specifications, and ensure all listings remain complete and up to date.

**Website Content Updates:** Make routine changes to website content, product pages, categories, collections, banners, links, downloadable documents, and other sections when required.

**Product Categories and Variations:** Organize products under the correct categories and manage product options or variations such as size, colour, finish, material, configuration, and model.

**Pricing and Availability Updates:** Update product prices, promotional information, availability, stock status, and other commercial details based on approved instructions.

**Product Image Management:** Upload, rename, resize, organize, replace, and arrange product images to ensure they are displayed clearly and correctly on the website.

**Website Quality Checking:** Review published product pages to confirm that images, descriptions, prices, specifications, variations, links, and page layouts are displaying correctly.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Maintain spreadsheets, organize information, check records for accuracy, apply formulas, remove duplicate entries, and ensure data is formatted correctly.

**AI-Assisted Data Processing:** Use AI tools to help organize large amounts of information, structure unformatted data, summarize documents, categorize records, and convert rough information into clear and usable formats.

**AI-Assisted Product Content:** Use AI tools to help prepare, rewrite, shorten, standardize, or improve product names, descriptions, specifications, and website content while maintaining factual and technical accuracy.

**Data Cleaning and Standardization:** Use spreadsheet functions and AI-assisted tools to identify missing information, formatting inconsistencies, duplicate entries, spelling errors, and incorrect data.

**Basic E-Commerce SEO Support:** Assist with preparing clear product titles, descriptions, categories, image names, page information, and search-friendly content based on company guidelines.

**File Management:** Organize digital files, folders, product images, documents, spreadsheets, and internal records in a clear and structured manner.

**Document Processing:** Extract and organize information from PDFs, quotations, supplier documents, catalogues, images, and other files using appropriate digital and AI tools.

**Administrative Support:**  
Support the office, sales, marketing, purchasing, and operations teams with basic back-office, website, and administrative tasks.

**Quality Checking:** Review all entered, uploaded, and AI-generated information carefully to identify errors, correct mistakes, and ensure records are complete and accurate.

**AI Output Verification:** Check all AI-generated content before use. Ensure that product specifications, dimensions, prices, customer details, supplier information, and technical data have not been incorrectly changed or invented.

**Data Confidentiality:** Handle customer, supplier, pricing, product, website, and company information responsibly and maintain confidentiality at all times.

Requirements & Qualifications

**Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of experience in data entry, e-commerce operations, website product uploading, back-office operations, administration, product data management, or a similar role.

**E-Commerce Experience:** Previous experience uploading and maintaining products on an e-commerce website or content management system is preferred.

**Product Data Skills:** Ability to understand and organize product names, descriptions, dimensions, specifications, materials, finishes, images, prices, categories, and variations.

**Data Entry Skills:** Good typing speed, strong accuracy, and the ability to enter and update large amounts of information consistently.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Good working knowledge of spreadsheets, including formatting, sorting, filtering, formulas, data validation, duplicate removal, and basic data analysis.

**AI Skills:** Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar platforms to organize information, improve written content, assist with spreadsheet work, and increase productivity.

**AI Prompting:** Ability to write clear instructions and prompts to generate accurate, structured, and relevant outputs.

**English Requirement:** Excellent English reading, writing, verbal communication, and comprehension skills are required. The candidate must be able to understand product information, website instructions, internal processes, and written feedback and communicate professionally in English.

**Attention to Detail:** Must be able to check information carefully, identify errors, compare website listings against original sources, and avoid mistakes.

**Organization:** Must be able to maintain clean records, structured folders, properly named files, accurately updated spreadsheets, and organized website listings.

**Technology:** Must be comfortable learning new e-commerce platforms, content management systems, company software, AI tools, and digital workflows.

**Attitude:** Reliable, punctual, focused, responsible, willing to learn, and able to follow instructions and complete tasks within agreed timelines.

**Why Join Us?**

Stable office-based role with opportunities for professional growth.

Opportunity to gain practical experience in e-commerce website management, product uploading, data entry, and digital operations.

Opportunity to develop practical experience using AI tools in product management, website content, and business operations.

Supportive team environment where accuracy, efficiency, consistency, communication, and responsibility are recognized.

Opportunity to work with product data and e-commerce operations for a growing office furniture company.

**Please apply only for the advertised position.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Data entry: 4 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Manager, AI Services Consultant– Job Description**

  

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionising how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Manager role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimisation.

  

**Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realise measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

**Strategic Accountabilities**

* **Technical Expertise & Guidance:** Provide expert advice on the **implementation and optimisation of Zendesk AI products,** ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* **Change Management & Training:** Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and **integration of AI solutions** within customer organisations.
* **Successful Project Delivery:** Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, both your own and your team’s, owning delivery quality, capacity and utilization across the team, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
* **Tactical solutions for business outcomes:** Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.
* **Team Building & Leadership:** Build and lead the new AI Delivery team end to end, including hiring and onboarding, defining the delivery methodology and ways of working, assigning tasks and workloads, conducting performance evaluations, and creating individual growth plans to build a high-performing team.

  

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**

  

**Strategic Skills & Expertise**

* **Consulting Expertise:** Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Strong Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* **Technical Proficiency in AI:** Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimise these solutions effectively.
* **Agility and Adaptability:** Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting-edge solutions to clients.

  

**Qualifications**

* Must have a minimum of 8+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.
* Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS; either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting.
* **Strong hands-on experience working with API integration, specifically REST APIs, with a solid understanding of JSON and SQL scripting.**
* **End-to-end team handling experience, including conducting performance evaluations, creating growth plans, and assigning tasks.**
* Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommend mitigations to secure retention and growth.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Excellent program management and cross-functional influence skills.
* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus.
Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.  

  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

description:
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.

* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.

* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.

  
**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**

* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.


\#LI\-RK1

description:
Job Description
  
  

At Accenture, we believe your career is about what you want to be and who you want to be. It’s about bringing your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. Here, you’ll match your ingenuity with the latest technology to do incredible things. Together, we can create positive, long\-lasting change.
  
  

**We are:**  

Our Solution Advisory team is a specialty sales advisory service within Commercial Services. We are specialists aligned to Accenture’s priority business offerings with expertise in how to go\-to\-market and best position Accenture to win work. We are the sales lab that works with offering leadership, equipping them with relevant market insights, customized sales messages, and curated sales assets to originate, sell, and win.

An experienced Senior Manager who is comfortable leading a team and working with senior Accenture stakeholders. You have an executive presence, deep expertise in the topic area, and established relationships leadership team in APAC from among Tech Strategy \& Transformation and/or other Digital Core constituents. Well versed with what it takes to win consulting work, allowing you to build trust and effectively partner with the managing directors that lead the sales pursuits. Planning and Origination
  
  

Support annual planning to outline sales targets, target clients, and enhancement of sales assets.
  
  

Conduct ongoing research to identify which companies and opportunities to target over next 6\-12 months.
  
  

Conduct sales / pipeline reviews with leaders.
  
  

Prepare for and support conversations with potential clients.
  
  

Proposals / Orals
  
  

Define proposal response requirements and best sales messaging approach.
  
  

Bring the latest knowledge and best of content to each opportunity (e.g., industry trends benchmarking, competitive insights, etc.)
  
  

Shape the overall solution (approach, team, pricing, differentiators, etc.) to best fit the deal requirements.
  
  

Prepare and help lead orals with innovating ways of selling to help differentiate Accenture.
  
  

Leverage Claude, Enterprise ChatGPT, and other AI and Agentic AI capabilities Accenture offers in your day\-to\-day work.
  
  

Content Management / Continuous Improvement
  
  

Develop go\-to\-market approach / assets.
  
  

Maintain global repository of sales assets (e.g., proposals, stage 0 decks credentials, etc.)
  
  

Conduct reviews (loss / delivery) with client teams to understand how we can improve and harvest deliverables.
  
  

Stay relevant through training, research, client interaction and feedback sessions.
  
  

**Here is what you need:**  

Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering
  
  

10\+ years functional experience in the Digital Core space
  
  

A minimum of 5 years in sales or consulting at Accenture
  
  

English language fluency (oral and written)
  
  

Must support/mirror working hours for the supported Market Unit or other business area.
  
  

Must be flexible with working hours to meet shifting business needs.
  
  

Must have good internet connectivity and distraction\-free environment for working at home, in accordance with local guidelines.

Experience in Sales and Business Development

* Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including revenue\-sharing arrangements, API monetization deals, and platform licensing frameworks

* Develop and own executive\-level business cases and investment theses for new monetization initiatives, presenting to senior leadership

* Serve as the primary external relationship owner for strategic monetization partners, managing C\-suite and senior stakeholder engagement
* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning
* Provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams on monetization deal structures, market dynamics, and competitive landscape
* Drive organizational alignment on monetization partnership priorities, influencing roadmap decisions and resource allocation across business units

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi\-party commercial agreements including revenue\-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large\-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C\-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high\-stakes deal environments with accountability for company\-level outcomes

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities.
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures.
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions.
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions.
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making.
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders.
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk.
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools.
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers.
* Promote security as a business enabler and support the adoption of secure\-by\-design principles across supplier engagements.
* Ensure suppliers understand and adhere to Vodafone’s security standards and regulatory obligations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experience working in a pre\-sales, sourcing, risk assessment or supplier security environment, evaluating responses and determining security recommendations.
* Strong ability to communicate security requirements, risks and mitigation measures to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, traffic flows, network architecture and security best practices.
* Experience managing and influencing stakeholders across different levels of an organisation.
* Significant professional experience in information technology and cyber security, ideally within supplier risk, security assurance or governance roles.
* Knowledge of cloud security, web services security, container security, connectivity, identity and access management, network security and penetration testing concepts.
* Understanding of security governance across Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
* Expertise across telecommunications technologies including:
	+ Switching and routing technologies
	+ Routers, modems and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs)
	+ Radio Access Networks (RAN)
	+ Core routers, firewalls and border gateways
	+ Mobile devices, tablets and IoT environments
	+ Mobile Private Networks (MPN) using 4G/5G technologies
* University degree in Information Security or an equivalent discipline.
* One or more recognised industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, GIAC, TOGAF, SABSA or equivalent.
* 5\+ years of experience in cyber security.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to influence supplier security decisions across a global telecommunications environment.
* Exposure to complex cyber security, supplier assurance and regulatory compliance challenges.
* Collaboration with business, technology and cyber security specialists across multiple functions.
* Ability to contribute directly to Vodafone’s supply chain security strategy and risk reduction objectives.
* Experience working with evolving telecom security regulations and industry\-leading security practices.
* Opportunity to shape secure\-by\-design adoption across supplier ecosystems.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced supplier cyber security assessment and assurance techniques.
* Regulatory compliance evaluation, including UK Telecom Security requirements.
* Security risk quantification, recommendation development and risk mitigation planning.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect

CSQ427R264


At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  

  

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
  

  

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post\-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
  

  

**The impact you will have:**
* Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
* Lead the post\-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts

* Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations

* Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
* Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer\-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
	+ Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
	+ Enablement / user growth plan
	+ Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
	+ Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning \& optimization)
	+ Executive and operational governance
* Provide internal and external updates \- KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression \- to your Technical GM

**What we look for:**
* 10\+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
* Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
* Experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
* Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
* Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
* Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
* Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
* Experience conducting open\-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
* Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**


Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
